title: BricsCAD workflows and connector status
description: Explore BricsCAD workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

BricsCAD

BricsCAD combines DWG drafting, 3D modelling and mechanical or BIM-oriented design tools.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Edit a standards-based DWG

Start from the controlled drawing, units and reference files. In the intended BricsCAD preview, edit a standards-based DWG; the visible result is revised linework with the changed dimensions called out. Review scale, geometry and drawing standard before accepting or exporting it.

Develop a direct 3D model

Begin with the agreed layer, block and reference structure. In the intended BricsCAD preview, develop a direct 3D model; the visible result is a coordinated sheet view with conflicts exposed. Review layer ownership, reference paths and annotation legibility before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate drawing revisions

Use the checked model-space and sheet-space views. In the intended BricsCAD preview, coordinate drawing revisions; the visible result is a revision-ready drawing package with its change set visible. Review title data, issue scope and plotted output before accepting or exporting it.
